# Hunter Products Inc.

> Hunter Products Inc. (Secaucus, NJ, est. 1970) sells portable brush plating (selective plating) equipment, tungsten-carbide coating systems and micro-abrasive blasters. Products ship same day from New Jersey on orders placed by 2 PM ET on business days.

Product lines:
- Micro-Metallizer: brush plating system made of a variable DC power supply, connector cables and self-contained plating pens (gold 24K/18K/14K, silver, nickel, black nickel, copper, tin, zinc, rhodium, palladium, chrome color, heavy-duty versions, degreasers). No tank, bath or plating waste. Standard pens build 1.5 to 1.8 µm, heavy-duty pens 3 to 3.6 µm. Kits from $400, pens $65 to $310.
- Carbitron 300: deposits tungsten carbide on tools and instruments to increase hardness, wear resistance and heat tolerance (including diamond dusting of surgical instrument jaws). $495.
- Micro-Jet 200: micro-abrasive blaster for precision cleaning and surface prep. $495.

Contact: hunter@hunterproducts.com, (908) 526-8440, 20 Aquarium Drive, Secaucus, NJ 07094.
